svg.aria-label: A cutaway of six layers, all owned by one person: experience, agents and orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, governance and compliance, data and integration, and platform and delivery. Dashed lines on the right mark the seams where a project usually hands off between teams.

g.data-note: Most AI work is judged here, by someone who never saw the prompt.
g.aria-label: experience. Most AI work is judged here, by someone who never saw the prompt.
g.text: the screen the person actually uses

g.data-note: Which model, which tool, which order — and what happens when one is down.
g.aria-label: agents & orchestration. Which model, which tool, which order — and what happens when one is down.
g.text: retrieval, tools, memory, routing between models

g.data-note: You cannot improve what you cannot score, or defend what you cannot reproduce.
g.aria-label: evaluation & guardrails. You cannot improve what you cannot score, or defend what you cannot reproduce.

g.data-note: In a regulated domain this is not a phase at the end. It is a design constraint.
g.aria-label: governance & compliance. In a regulated domain this is not a phase at the end. It is a design constraint.
g.text: policy, access, audit trail, data residency, explainability

g.data-note: Fragmented operations rarely have a storage problem. They have a truth problem.
g.aria-label: data & integration. Fragmented operations rarely have a storage problem. They have a truth problem.
g.text: one record, many systems that never agreed on it

g.data-note: The bill and the pager both arrive after go-live. Design for both.
g.aria-label: platform & delivery. The bill and the pager both arrive after go-live. Design for both.
g.text: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, cost
